svg.title: Side corner position
svg.desc: Two top views of the one-sided puller, before left and after right, the plug end at the top. Left: the defaults with hand size set to Custom, a 25 mm wide plug in teal. Right: side corner position at 14.65 mm: moves the two widest corners of the body outline up toward the plug end or down toward the cord end. Marked in red: 1, the wing openings: the two openings beside the pocket. 2, the body edge: the outer outline. Everything else follows the outline.
